objective: Demonstrate that one frozen public-information Drop7 policy has an average final score above 1000000 points per game and deploy that same policy in the TypeScript component.

engine.requiredBeforeProtectedRun: Reverify exact native/TypeScript trajectory parity if either engine hash changes.

allowed: moves remaining before the next row rise
forbidden: history not represented by the public state

candidateFreeze.rule: No policy, model, search, or hyperparameter change is allowed between freezing and its protected validation run.

protectedValidation.cohortRule: Use the first never-read aligned block of 256 seeds in ascending order. Never reuse a failed block for selection, training, calibration, or another candidate.
protectedValidation.failure: Reject the frozen candidate. A later materially new candidate must use the next never-read 256-seed block.

prerequisites: The frozen native candidate passed protected validation.
The TypeScript evaluator/search passed exact or explicitly tolerance-bounded native parity on non-protected fixtures.
The policy/model/search artifacts and fixed work configuration remain unchanged.

statistics.censoring: At 2000 moves, retain only the score already earned. Because game score is monotone, it is a conservative lower bound on that game's final score; do not extrapolate it.
requiredReporting: arithmetic mean, median, lower quartile, and minimum observed score
bootstrap and Student-t lower confidence bounds
per-game seed, observed score, moves, censor flag, and result checksum
